correctness.rationale: For exponent p^e, Frobenius annihilates the maximal ideal, so any invertible tangent substitution is admissible. At exponent p^e+1, degree-(h+1) terms force a monomial tangent matrix; a least-degree obstruction forbids off-coordinate terms in every image. Surjectivity follows by finite local Nakayama; exact independent coefficient counts yield both orders. Exhaustive direct substitution censuses at (d,p,n)=(2,2,2),(2,2,3),(2,3,3), plus one three-variable row census and seeded larger checks reproduce predicted numbers without assuming the formula.

value.rationale: A complete uniform automorphism classification and exact group order for each of two infinite families of zero-dimensional complete intersections detects a sharp change from GL_d(q) to monomial tangent symmetry at consecutive truncation exponents in every dimension and finite characteristic. Such algebra-automorphism groups are natural invariants; the phenomenon is structurally distinct from characteristic-zero automorphism theory and is not a selected finite numerical case.
